# Al Safwa Trading

Al Safwa Trading supplies industrial tools, equipment and machinery in Oman, with supply, rental, repair and maintenance support for contractors, workshops and industrial businesses.

## Primary pages
- https://alsafwaoman.com/
- https://alsafwaoman.com/products
- https://alsafwaoman.com/brands
- https://alsafwaoman.com/rental
- https://alsafwaoman.com/services
- https://alsafwaoman.com/repair
- https://alsafwaoman.com/request-quote
- https://alsafwaoman.com/contact

## Product divisions
Power Tools; Hand Tools; Safety Equipment; Motors & Pumps; Spare Parts; Machinery; Rental Equipment.

## Customer intent
Users can browse products and brands, request a quotation, ask about availability, arrange equipment rental, and contact Al Safwa Trading for repair or maintenance support.

## Business area
Oman, with Muscat as the primary stated location and Oman-wide service positioning.

## Contact
WhatsApp / phone: +968 90167345

## Accuracy
Product availability, pricing, specifications and brand sourcing should be treated as catalogue information and verified with Al Safwa Trading before purchase.
